name: ws_attn_pipe
desc: Minimal WARP-SPECIALIZED FlashAttention forward: a producer warp streams K/V tiles into a 2-stage double-buffered ring (full[]/empty[] mbarriers, phase reuse across KV tiles) while a consumer warp runs online-softmax attention from the ring. The FA3 mainloop structure (producer/consumer warps + multi-stage mbarrier handshake) at tractable scale (scalar FMA, no WGMMA; flat args, no Params). Single CTA, 2 warps. Verified vs a CPU attention oracle.
